page.notes: Printed lines in the three top columns are copied in full; the letter Z above its entries sits in a decorative initial. Doubtful readings: "tur" (Vitulum tur peccatum), "initiu", "Zelores", "ceffum", "INIS" (first word of Genesis 3:19 lies under a woodcut initial). The left-margin scripture references beside the Genesis and Exodus lines are printed as "3", "9", "40", "22", "32", "19", "25", "3"; the right-margin ones as "16", "15", "12", "10". The "Abulon" line carries a Z-shaped mark. Bottom right of the page shows a gathering mark that is too faint to read reliably, so no signature is given. No page number is printed. The text is in a mixture of roman and italic; italic was not marked in the index lines. The spelling of u/v and i/j has been modernised as instructed in the index lines, but the printed form of "Zelores" and the word "tur" are copied as printed.
